customManagers.description: pnpm installed in the Node Dockerfiles must match packageManager in package.json

packageRules.description: One PR for pnpm: packageManager + lockfile + the Dockerfile installs
pnpm 12 rejects packages younger than 1 day (minimumReleaseAge); wait longer before proposing updates
api (Gradle/Maven dependencies, Gradle wrapper): same 3-day wait as npm, so a release has time to be pulled or patched
The api's embedded test PostgreSQL must stay on the production major (helm/api postgresql.image); a major is a planned data migration
Java runs on LTS releases only (25 now): don't propose non-LTS JDK images
Major upgrades need code changes: only open a PR when approved in the Dependency Dashboard
